```{r}
#Load in data

ado_data <- read.csv("data/data_ado_clean.csv")

adult_data <- read.csv("data/data_adult_clean.csv")

#Keeping only what I need

#Ados

ado_data_fin <- ado_data %>% 
  select(id, condition, age, diplome, mean_rc1, mean_rc2, 
         mean_arg1, mean_arg2, crt_accuracy)

#Adding an "age group" column

ado_data_fin$age_group <- "Adolescent"


#Adults

adult_data_fin <- adult_data %>% 
  select(id, condition, age, diplome, mean_rc1, mean_rc2, 
         mean_arg1, mean_arg2, crt_accuracy)

#Adding an "age group" column
adult_data_fin$age_group <- "Adult"

#Creating one data set for both

all_data_fin <- bind_rows(ado_data_fin, adult_data_fin) 

all_data_fin <- na.omit(all_data_fin)

all_counts <- all_data_fin %>% 
  group_by(age_group) %>% 
  count()

```

```{r}
#z-scoring the variables - explanation

#N.B.
#z-scores for general conspiracy and fallacious arguments have been z-scored
#according to the pre-test scores in order to see variation relative to
#baseline

#z-scores for age and education were computed normally

#CRT scores were logit transformed to reduce boundedness
#and improve scaling of proportion data
```

```{r}
#z-score calculations

#GENERAL CONSPIRACY -> code "rc"
#Pre-exposure mean + SD
rc_pre_mean <- mean(
  all_data_fin$mean_rc1,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(rc_pre_mean)

rc_pre_sd <- sd(
  all_data_fin$mean_rc1,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(rc_pre_sd)

#Pre-exposure z-score
all_data_fin$rc_pre_z <-
  (all_data_fin$mean_rc1 - rc_pre_mean)/
  (rc_pre_sd)

#Post-exposure z-score SCALED ON PRE-EXPOSURE
all_data_fin$rc_post_z <-
  (all_data_fin$mean_rc2 - rc_pre_mean)/
  (rc_pre_sd)

###############

#SPECIFIC CONSPIRACY -> code "arg"
#Pre-exposure mean + SD
arg_pre_mean <- mean(
  all_data_fin$mean_arg1,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(arg_pre_mean)

arg_pre_sd <- sd(
  all_data_fin$mean_arg1,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

print(arg_pre_sd)

#Pre-exposure z-score
all_data_fin$arg_pre_z <-
  (all_data_fin$mean_arg1 - arg_pre_mean)/
  (arg_pre_sd)

#Post-exposure z-score SCALED ON PRE-EXPOSURE
all_data_fin$arg_post_z <-
  (all_data_fin$mean_arg2 - arg_pre_mean)/
  (arg_pre_sd)

#Sanity check

mean(all_data_fin$rc_pre_z, na.rm = TRUE)

sd(all_data_fin$rc_pre_z, na.rm = TRUE)

mean(all_data_fin$arg_pre_z, na.rm = TRUE)

sd(all_data_fin$arg_pre_z, na.rm = TRUE)

#Means close to 0, SDs close to 1

#Education z-score

dip_mean <- mean(all_data_fin$diplome, na.rm = TRUE)

dip_sd <- sd(all_data_fin$diplome, na.rm = TRUE)

all_data_fin$dip_z <- 
  (all_data_fin$diplome - dip_mean)/
  (dip_sd)

```

```{r}
#Logit transforming the CRT

#Continuity correction, to keep the scale between 0 and 1
#formula p = (x+0.5)/(n+1)

#Percentage -> proportion
all_data_fin$crt_prop <- all_data_fin$crt_accuracy / (100)

#Proportion -> counts
all_data_fin$crt_count <- all_data_fin$crt_prop * 4

#Continuity correction so that all values fall between 0 and 1
#Using formula p = (x + 0.5)/(n+1)

all_data_fin$crt_adj <- (all_data_fin$crt_count + 0.5) / (5)

#Checking that min value is 0.1, max value is 0.9
min(all_data_fin$crt_adj)
max(all_data_fin$crt_adj)

#Logit transforming the CRT scores
all_data_fin$crt_logit <- qlogis(all_data_fin$crt_adj)

#Checking that min value is -2.20 and max is 2.20
min(all_data_fin$crt_logit)
max(all_data_fin$crt_logit)

#Checking the distribution
hist(all_data_fin$crt_logit)

summary(all_data_fin$crt_logit)
```

```{r}
#Preprocessing for analysis

#Converting condition to factor
all_data_fin$condition <- factor(
  all_data_fin$condition,
  levels = c("control", "conspiracy")
)

#Converting age to factor
all_data_fin$age_group <- factor(
  all_data_fin$age_group,
  levels = c("Adult", "Adolescent")
)

```

```{r}
#Correlational matrix

cor(
  all_data_fin %>% 
    select(
      rc_pre_z,
      arg_pre_z,
      crt_logit,
      dip_z
    ),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)
```

```{r}
#MODEL FOR RQ1

#Power analysis

pwr.f2.test(
  u = 4,        
  v = 236,     
  f2 = 0.093, #effect size
  sig.level = 0.05
)

```

```{r}
#RQ1: Does CRT predict general conspiracy belief? (replication q)

#Predicting z-scored climate-change belief (belief in ACC) from
#CRT (logit-transformed), age group, their interaction, an education

model_rq1 <- lm(
  rc_pre_z ~
    crt_logit * age_group +
    dip_z,
  data = all_data_fin
)

summary(model_rq1)
confint(model_rq1)

plot(model_rq1)
vif(model_rq1)
#Effects of CRT and CRT x Age Group
```

```{r}
#PLOTS FOR RQ1
```

```{r}
#Plotting the predicted relationship according to the model

# Get predicted values
interaction_rq1 <- predictions(model_rq1, #uses fitted regression model to 
                    #generate the y-values
                    newdata = datagrid( #clean grid of hypothetic x-values
                      crt_logit = seq(min(all_data_fin$crt_logit, na.rm=T),
                                      max(all_data_fin$crt_logit, na.rm=T),
                                      length.out = 100),
                      age_group = c("Adolescent", "Adult")))

ggplot(interaction_rq1, aes(x = crt_logit, y = estimate, 
                  color = age_group, fill = age_group)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  labs(x = "CRT Score (logit)",
       y = "Predicted ACC Belief (z)",
       color = "Age Group",
       fill = "Age Group") + 
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme( #insert my favorite theme for consistency throughout!
  panel.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.75),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "light grey", linewidth = 0.25),
  panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray 95", linewidth = 0.25),
  legend.key = element_rect(color = NA),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.x = element_text (size = 12),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill='white', color=NA) 
  )

ggsave("rq1_prediction_plot.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```


```{r}
#Correlation coefficient plot

tidy(model_rq1, conf.int = TRUE) %>% #takes lm() and turns it into table 
#with columns for term, estimate, SE, t, and p, conf.int adds columns for
#low and high confidence
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% #drops intercept
  mutate(term = dplyr::recode(term,
    "crt_logit" = "CRT",
    "age_groupAdolescent" = "Age Group (Adolescent)",
    "dip_z" = "Education",
    "crt_logit:age_groupAdolescent" = "CRT × Age Group")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = term)) + #Beta on x-axis, names on y
  geom_point() + #adds a dot at each coefficient's beta value
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0.2) +
  #geom_errorbarh is horizontal error bars
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  #vline = vertical dashed line at 0
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Coefficient Estimate (β)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme(
  panel.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", linewidth = 0.75),
  panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "light grey", linewidth = 0.25),
  panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray 95", linewidth = 0.25),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.x = element_text (size = 12),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
  plot.background = element_rect(fill='white', color=NA) 
  )

ggsave("rq1_coefficient_plot.png", width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
#MODEL FOR RQ2

#Modeling effect of CRT on post-exposure scores

model_rq2 <- lm(
  rc_post_z ~
    rc_pre_z +
    crt_logit * age_group * condition +
    dip_z,
  data = all_data_fin
)

summary(model_rq2)
confint(model_rq2)

plot(model_rq2)
vif(model_rq2)

#Only main effects of RC, CRT, and Condition
```

```{r}
#Same plot as above, for RQ2

interaction_rq2 <- predictions(model_rq2,
                    newdata = datagrid(
                      rc_pre_z = mean(all_data_fin$rc_pre_z, na.rm = TRUE),
                      crt_logit = seq(min(all_data_fin$crt_logit, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      max(all_data_fin$crt_logit, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      length.out = 100),
                      age_group = c("Adolescent", "Adult"),
                      condition = c("control", "conspiracy")))

ggplot(interaction_rq2, aes(x = crt_logit, y = estimate,
                             color = condition, fill = condition)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
```

```{r}
#Coefficient plot
tidy(model_rq2) %>% pull(term)

tidy(model_rq2, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(term = case_when(
    term == "crt_logit" ~ "CRT",
    term == "rc_pre_z" ~ "Baseline ACC Belief",
    term == "age_groupAdolescent" ~ "Age Group (Adolescent)",
    term == "conditionconspiracy" ~ "Condition (Conspiracy)",
    term == "dip_z" ~ "Education",
    term == "crt_logit:age_groupAdolescent" ~ "CRT × Age Group",
    term == "crt_logit:conditionconspiracy" ~ "CRT × Condition",
    term == "age_groupAdolescent:conditionconspiracy" ~ "Age Group × Condition",
    term == "crt_logit:age_groupAdolescent:conditionconspiracy" ~ "CRT × Age Group × Condition",
    TRUE ~ term
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = term)) +
  geom_point() +
```

```{r}
  arg_post_z ~
    arg_pre_z +
    crt_logit * age_group * condition +
    dip_z,
  data = all_data_fin
)

vif(model_rq3)
```
